content: Do I need to lift heavy to build muscle?

No, you don't have to lift heavy to build muscle. Research shows that sets taken close to failure build similar muscle across a wide range of loads, roughly 5 to 30 reps. Lighter weights work if the sets are hard enough, but they take more time and effort per set. 💪

Your goal is a 100 kg bench, and that's a strength goal. For that, you'll need to train heavy (low reps, near your max) regularly, because strength is specific to the load you practice with. My suggestion is heavy work on the main lifts, plus moderate-rep sets (8–15) for muscle volume. Ain't nothin' but a peanut!
